scenes.name: Kärcher WV 1 window vac
scenes.vo: The Kärcher W V one. Run it over the inside of the window in the morning and the condensation goes into the tank instead of down the wall. Amazon has it at thirty five pounds against a forty four ninety nine R R P, sold and dispatched by Amazon.

scenes.name: vs Argos

scenes.vo: Argos sells the exact same W V one at forty pounds, and Currys is forty four ninety nine. On Amazon it's thirty five. That's a fiver back in your pocket, just as the heating goes on.
